ficha_publicada.complicacoes: African Protector: Congorilla takes his role as protector of the African lands he and his gorilla tribe call home very seriously, but he is also a mentor and partner to other African heroes, lending them the benefit of his century of experience. Severed Bond: The body of Congo Bill was killed with the mind of the Congorilla inside it. There may be unforeseen side effects to Congo Bill’s mind remaining inside the Golden Gorilla’s body for an extended period.
